assertions.name: A_locality_C3_D_zero
assertions.source: deuteron has no triple ⇒ C₃(D)=0 exactly (the one gate that passes).

description: EXPLORATORY scope-(a): different-context (per-knot-trace side) attack on the open GAP-A-3 k(A) extensivity gap (bean qou-7uxa). Casts μ_ext−1 = C₂+C₃, freezes C₂ to the merged Lean-grounded Mayer-b₂ bond object 1/(tr_a·tr_b) (deuteron-anchored, one a-priori scale), and tests whether the residual C₃ is a clean genuinely-connected 3-body cumulant (coordinator's full Ursell formula, from real joint traces incl. here-computed diproton/dineutron). NEGATIVE on 4 grounds: b₂ bond-sum overshoots (μ_ext sub-extensive in bonds); naive triple 1/(tr³) is disconnected; the residual does not track the genuine connected cumulant (b₃(T)≈b₃(³He)≈+0.94, b₄(⁴He)=−2.21, sign flip); the connected cumulant is NOT bar-even (I-par fail). No parameter-free connected-triple makes ⁴He the max. Constrains, does not close. No fit, no BW, no wiring.

data.conn_verdict: naive 1/(tr^3) disconnected (cumulant=0); genuine joint-trace cumulant well-defined but residual does not track it
data.final_verdict: scope-(a) NEGATIVE — the connected 3-cluster channel is CONSTRAINED, not closed, on four independent grounds: (1) MAGNITUDE — the frozen Mayer-b₂ bond-sum, forced to absolute μ_ext scale by the only a-priori anchor (the pure-2-body deuteron), OVERSHOOTS T/³He/⁴He by 4–5× because μ_ext−1 is strongly SUB-extensive in bond count (D 4.85/1 bond vs ⁴He 8.31/6 bonds); the residual C₃ is dominated by this overshoot. (2) I-conn — the naive per-knot triple 1/(tr_a tr_b tr_c) is a product of 1-body traces ⇒ connected cumulant ≡ 0 ⇒ fully disconnected (mean-field, already inside the ceiling). The genuinely-connected joint-trace cumulant is well-defined (b₃(T)=+0.939, b₃(³He)=+0.951 — nearly isospin-blind; b₄(⁴He)=−2.210) but the residual does NOT track it (C₃/b = −12.6/−12.2/+9.5; no single scale, sign flips). (3) I-par — the connected cumulant is NOT bar-even (b₃ shifts ~−19%, b₄ −24% under q↦q⁻¹; the single-nucleon trace itself shifts +12–13%), so the object carries bar-odd (p−n) content — wrong channel for the bar-even scale. (4) 4He-max — b₄(⁴He) is NEGATIVE, opposite in sign to the positive b₃(T/³He), so no parameter-free connected-triple makes ⁴He the maximum; the junk triple-count is more self-consistent than the connected cumulant. A-locality C₃(D)=0 holds trivially (the one gate that passes). Reported to #3808: freeze nothing new; the per-knot-trace side does not supply k(A). No fit, no wiring.
